tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool neutral so the two sides' hues carry the meaning.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tabs, table and chart grounds, idle match buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface; the selected tab underline; the highlight outline on a chat message.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, KPI labels, table headers, axis labels, message meta line.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards and tables, chart grid lines, neutral chip borders.

tokens.name: us
tokens.usage: OUR side: our offers, our reservation line, our target curve, the selected match border, focus rings. Never used for the rival.

tokens.name: us-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of our chat bubbles and of the selected match button. Text on it is ink or muted.

tokens.name: them
tokens.usage: THE RIVAL: their offers, their (hidden) reservation, the engine's estimate of it. Light theme: 3.6:1 on them-soft, so use it for marks, lines and 12px+ semibold text, not for small running text.

tokens.name: them-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of rival chat bubbles, the demo/sample badge and the fallback chip.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Semantic good: deal closed, AC_next/AC_time accept marker, better metric, promotion verdict. Not an accent.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the verdict pill, decision chips and good heatmap cells.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Semantic bad: walk-away, worse metric, prompt-injection flag, weak heatmap cells.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the injection chip and weak heatmap cells.

tokens.name: zopa
tokens.usage: Translucent band between both reservations on the offer chart. Arena mode only: in a tournament the ZOPA is unknown and the band is not drawn.

families.body: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: meta

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutter at every width.

tokens.usage: Flags / chips.

tokens.usage: Match buttons.
